issues.issue: Is the principal male claimant at risk in Haiti on religious grounds, and is Port-de-Paix a viable internal flight alternative?
issues.applicant_position: Male claimant says rival pastors attacked him in La Croix because of his religious work and he fears persecution if he returns to Haiti.
issues.result_quote: the panel finds that the principal male claimant and his children have not established that they face a serious possibility of persecution in Haiti

issues.issue: Does the child claimant face a well-founded fear as a male Haitian child at risk of gang recruitment or violence?
issues.applicant_position: Counsel argues the child faces persecution as a Haitian male child due to violence, gang recruitment and state incapacity.
issues.result_quote: I do not find that XXXX XXXX XXXX has a well-founded fear of persecution because he is a Haitian child.

issues.issue: Do the female claimants face a forward-looking well-founded fear of gender-based violence in Haiti, given state protection?
issues.applicant_position: Female claimants fear sexual and gender-based violence in Haiti; the principal female claimant was raped there in 2012.
issues.result_quote: Therefore, I find that female claimants do not have a well-founded fear of persecution in Haiti because of SGBV on a forward-looking assessment.

issues.issue: Are there compelling reasons under s. 108(4) not to return the principal female claimant to Haiti?
issues.applicant_position: Principal female claimant says her past rape and resulting severe PTSD are compelling reasons not to return her to Haiti.
issues.result_quote: I therefore find compelling reasons for the principal female claimant not to be returned to Haiti.
